stemMd: After a warehouse introduced voice-directed picking, its error rate fell. Management attributes the improvement to the voice system. Which finding most weakens that explanation?

options.label: A
options.textMd: At the same time, the warehouse stopped stocking its most easily confused products.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The error rate remained lower for several months.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Workers received instructions on how to use the system.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The system can operate in three languages.

explanationMd: Look for another change capable of producing fewer errors. Removing easily confused products makes the task easier regardless of the picking technology, so the before-and-after comparison cannot isolate the system.

distractorRationale.c: Persistence alone does not identify the cause.
distractorRationale.b: Dislike does not show that accuracy failed to improve.
distractorRationale.e: Language capacity provides no alternative explanation for the decline.
distractorRationale.d: Training is compatible with a system-caused improvement.
